name: Scenario Cards (Bull / Base / Bear)
when_to_pick: Lay out a forecast or outlook as 2-4 side-by-side scenarios — classically bearish / base / bullish — each with a price target or outcome, an optional probability, and the drivers that would make it play out. Pick this for any market-forecast, price-projection or 'what could happen next' section where the point is the RANGE of outcomes and what tips the balance, not a single number. Tone each card by direction (bullish=up/green, bearish=down/red, neutral=base). For a head-to-head of two named options use versus_card; for many rows of attributes use comparison_table.

label.description: Scenario name, e.g. 'Bull case', 'Base case', 'Bear case'.

target.description: The headline outcome — a price target, range, or one-line result.

points.description: Optional drivers/conditions that would produce this scenario.
